news.headline: RTW Investments Reports 5.7% Passive Stake in uniQure
news.summary: RTW Investments and Roderick Wong disclosed beneficial ownership of roughly 3.94M ordinary shares (5.7%), after adding over 1.35M shares around uniQure's June 2026 public offering.

news.headline: uniQure Charts Accelerated Path With AMT-130
news.summary: Recap piece confirming uniQure's alignment with FDA on using 3-year Phase I/II data as the primary basis for an accelerated-approval BLA, with filing still slated for Q3 2026.

news.headline: uniQure (QURE) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
news.summary: Management detailed the accelerated-approval strategy for AMT-130 and reiterated that clinical updates for epilepsy and Fabry disease programs are expected H1 2027.

news.headline: uniQure Price Target Raised to $75 at Wells Fargo
news.summary: Wells Fargo raised PT to $75, Overweight, citing confidence ahead of the September four-year data readout.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, $65 Price Target
news.summary: Wolfe upgraded QURE to Outperform with a $65 price target, on an improved Huntington's therapy outlook.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure entered H2 2026 with over $810M in cash, extending its runway into 2030, and reaffirmed plans to submit the AMT-130 BLA (US) and MAA (UK) in Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year topline data (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: Four-year safety/efficacy readout on all 24 patients across the first two cohorts (12 high-dose, 12 low-dose), benchmarked against an updated ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD external control cohort. Data cut June 30, 2026; results not yet released as of Aug 26, 2026.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: 3-year Phase I/II data as primary basis for BLA under accelerated approval; FDA also requested agreement on a confirmatory study design before filing.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 UK MHRA Marketing Authorization Application
catalysts.detail: Parallel MAA submission to MHRA following a successful pre-submission meeting.

catalysts.label: Epilepsy and Fabry disease program updates
catalysts.detail: Clinical data/updates for AMT-191 (Fabry) and AMT-260 (refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy) programs.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA action on AMT-130 accelerated approval
catalysts.detail: Contingent on BLA acceptance and priority review following the Q3 2026 filing; exact PDUFA date not yet set.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results and corporate update; exact date not yet announced.

pulse: uniQure remains in a holding pattern of high anticipation heading into its AMT-130 four-year Huntington's data readout, still expected in September 2026 and not yet released as of Aug 26, 2026; shares have climbed into the low $50s (from roughly $40 in early August) as sell-side targets keep rising (Wells Fargo $75, Wolfe $65) and institutional holders like RTW Investments have added to positions. With FDA alignment on an accelerated-approval BLA path already secured and Q3 2026 BLA/MAA filings reaffirmed on the Q2 earnings call, the September data readout is now the single most important near-term catalyst for the stock.
